action: subtract a directional bent fissure from the selected base-volume face
divergence: Measured on a bare extruded body, uncut by the envelope: massv2 fracture removes 333 m3 (subtract) acting on 1 volume(s) (single). The BOOK records this word as subtract on single volumes. The two agree on both counts, so the second implementation is a restatement rather than a different word - it may still differ in proportion, which this bench does not measure.

mathematical_basis.reference: Aurenhammer, F. (1991) 'Voronoi diagrams - a survey of a fundamental geometric data structure', ACM Computing Surveys 23(3)
mathematical_basis.definition: Partition by a Voronoi diagram of seed points, each cell intersected with the solid. The pieces tile the original, so volume is conserved until a gap is opened between them.
mathematical_basis.shipped_as: 3ds Max and Houdini Voronoi fracture, RayFire
mathematical_basis.superseded_by_the_code: I filed fracture under Voronoi fracture, which tiles and therefore conserves volume. This word subtracts a fissure and keeps one body.

delivery_contract.why: A unary AST chain, a decompose() != 1 refusal inside every macro, and a maximum_components=1 promotion gate. The reason is written in candidate_analysis.py: a detached piece is no more architectural than a small Lego speck, and split wings or arrays must be joined by an explicit bridge or spine.
delivery_contract.note: So the BOOK record's `multiple` means how many volumes the operative involves, NOT how many bodies come back.

volume_law_finding.verdict: the expectation was wrong, not the code
volume_law_finding.explanation: BOOK p.28 is a bent fissure cut into one face, with a back layer deliberately retained (retained_back_ratio 0.32) so the host stays one volume. There is no Voronoi partition anywhere in the file. Reproduced: channel width 0.538, cut depth 13.6, two segments less their overlap = 92 m3 on 1920 m3 = -4.79%.
volume_law_finding.correction_to_the_standard_i_recorded: I filed fracture under Voronoi fracture, which tiles and therefore conserves volume. This word subtracts a fissure and keeps one body.
volume_law_finding.basis: box 20x12x8 under a 1/1 long_axis book_base_volume scope
